skill.name: instagram-comment-insights
skill.description: Analyze Instagram comments and replies through SocialDataX to identify feedback themes, customer concerns, unmet needs, and actionable recommendations.
skill.summary: Turn comments from selected Instagram posts into evidence-based feedback summaries, FAQ topics, and research questions.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown formatting, documented credential configuration, and readable Chinese text. The CLI example automatically executes an unpinned npm release, and optional unlimited pagination can exhaust service credits. No evidence found of embedded secrets, credential exfiltration, encrypted payloads, or prompt injection in the supplied files; the external package implementation was not supplied.

remediation.issue: The CLI examples execute socialdatax-skills@latest with automatic approval.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version, verify package integrity, and obtain installation consent before executing downloaded code with access to API credentials.

remediation.issue: The --all option has no default page or item limit on a credit-based service.
remediation.suggestion: Require an explicit retrieval budget, enforce page and item limits, and request confirmation before increasing limits or consuming additional credits.

content.user_title: Analyze Instagram Comments and Customer Needs
content.value_statement: Instagram comment threads can make customer concerns and recurring questions difficult to summarize. This skill uses SocialDataX results to organize visible feedback into evidence-based themes and actions.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve top-level Instagram comments from a supplied post URL through the documented SocialDataX CLI or available MCP tool.
Retrieve comment replies when the Instagram post ID and parent comment ID are known.
Expand retrieval using page tokens, page counts, and item limits while reporting the retrieved coverage.
Organize returned comments into themes, pain points, purchase concerns, unmet needs, and FAQ topics.
Separate visible comment quotations from interpretation and recommend content, product, or support actions.
Preserve partial results and resume from available pagination tokens without automatically restarting the first page.
limitations: Requires SocialDataX access, a configured SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY, and sufficient service credits.
The direct CLI requires Node.js, npm, network access, and execution permission; external package implementation is not included.
Conclusions cover only retrieved comments and replies from selected posts, not all Instagram users or the entire platform.
The documented workflow is read-only and does not log in, publish content, like posts, or send comment replies.

use_cases.title: Plan Follow-Up Content
use_cases.description: Identify recurring questions and discussion themes under a creator's post to prioritize future content.

use_cases.title: Investigate Product Friction
use_cases.description: Group visible purchase concerns and unmet needs into research questions supported by retrieved comments.

use_cases.title: Prepare Support FAQ Topics
use_cases.description: Turn repeated questions and reply-thread concerns into a draft FAQ and a prioritized support review list.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize One Comment Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the first comment page for [Instagram post URL]. Summarize themes and questions using only returned comments. State the sample limits.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: understand feedback on one post.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Purchase Concerns
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve at most [item limit] comments from [Instagram post URL]. Group purchase concerns and unmet needs. Separate visible quotations from your interpretation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare evidence for product research.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Reply Thread
prompt_templates.prompt: Review replies for post [post ID] and comment [comment ID], capped at [item limit] replies. Identify unresolved questions and draft FAQ topics. Do not publish replies.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: investigate a specific support discussion.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Bounded Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [Instagram post URL] for [research objective], limited to [page limit] pages and [item limit] comments. Request confirmation before expanding retrieval. Report coverage, evidence, concerns, FAQ topics, and prioritized actions. Preserve partial results and resume only from a valid returned token.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: conduct a scoped feedback review with controlled retrieval.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: summarize one retrieved page containing repeated questions about sizing and delivery.
output: Scope: one returned comment page; replies were not reviewed.
Themes: sizing guidance and delivery availability.
Interpretation: these questions suggest information gaps, not verified product defects.
Actions: review the size guide and clarify supported delivery regions.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: prepare a support review after comment retrieval stops with partial results.
output: Coverage: retrieval is incomplete; retained comments remain available for analysis.
FAQ topics: include only questions visible in retained comments.
Recovery: use the returned continuation token and remaining retrieval allowance.
Boundary: do not treat missing pages as evidence that further concerns do not exist.

best_practices: Set page and item limits before retrieval, and confirm the credit budget before expanding the sample.
Keep API keys in the configured environment, and review a pinned CLI package version before execution.
Report sample coverage and partial failures, and separate visible comment evidence from interpretation.
anti_patterns: Treating comments from one post or page as representative of the entire Instagram audience.
Using unlimited retrieval without a budget or repeatedly restarting a partially completed collection.
Inventing quotations, sharing API credentials, or presenting inferred needs as verified customer facts.

faq.question: What input should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide an Instagram post URL for comments. Reply retrieval also requires the post ID and parent comment ID.

faq.question: Does this require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY for the SocialDataX account. Requests depend on available service credits.

faq.question: Can I use the skill without configuring MCP?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented CLI uses Node.js and npm. An already available MCP tool is an alternative.

faq.question: Does it cover every comment or the entire platform?
faq.answer: No. Coverage depends on the selected posts, returned pages, reply retrieval, and chosen limits. Reports should state these boundaries.

faq.question: Can it post replies or modify my account?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow retrieves comments and replies for analysis. It does not log in, publish, like, or modify accounts.

faq.question: What happens when retrieval fails or credits run out?
faq.answer: Keep partial results and report incomplete coverage. Resolve the error, then resume from an available token within the remaining limits.
